title: BLOB PUT violates the read-only cache contract
summary: Network access and published BLOB identifier; token system is documented as coordination, not a confidentiality/security boundary. Source-contract confirmed; runtime unverified. Next: Reject RO uploads and isolate writable upload staging by intended operation/client
evidence: indigo_libs/indigo_server_tcp.c:355-380; indigo_libs/indigo_bus.c:1084-1119; indigo_libs/indigo_bus.c:836-854; transport-security.md section T03
